'''Elite Void Knight equipment''', commonly called '''elite void''', is a reward from the [[Pest Control]] [[Minigames|minigame]], and the upgraded version of regular [[Void Knight equipment]]. The set has two pieces, the [[elite void top]] and [[elite void robe]], and becomes available after completing the hard [[Western Provinces Diary]]. 

Upgrading to elite void costs 200 [[Void Knight commendation points|commendation points]] for each piece, for a total of 400 points to upgrade both the top and bottom. Players can upgrade their equipment by speaking to the [[Elite Void Knight]] at the [[Void Knights' Outpost]]. The regular Void Knight top and bottom are required for the upgrade.

Elite void equipment offers the same defence bonuses as the standard version, and counts as Void Knight gear for the purpose of [[Void Knight equipment#Set effects|Void Knight equipment's set effects]]. However, elite void has a different appearance, gives a [[Prayer]] bonus of +3 per piece (for a total of +6), and provides an additional damage boost of 2.5% to the Ranged set and 5% to the Magic set.

The equipment can be stored in the [[armour case]] of the [[costume room]] in a [[player-owned house]].

==Requirements==
Like regular Void Knight equipment, Elite Void requires the following skills to be worn: 42 [[Attack]], [[Strength]], [[Defence]], [[Magic]], [[Hitpoints]] and [[Ranged]], as well as 22 [[Prayer]]. 

The prerequisite of completing the hard [[Western Provinces Diary]] also entails multiple requirements:

* Full completion of the [[Swan Song]], [[Recipe for Disaster/Freeing King Awowogei|Freeing King Awowogei]], [[Eagles' Peak]], [[The Eyes of Glouphrie|Eyes of Glouphrie]], [[Big Chompy Bird Hunting]], and [[Rune Mysteries]] [[quests]]
* Started [[Mourning's End Part I]] and [[One Small Favour]]
* Defeated [[Zulrah]] and claimed 300 [[Chompy bird hunting|chompy kills]]
* The following stats are also needed to complete the diary tasks:
